poly_canonical: Merge rational coefficients at equal power triples and sort lexicographically by field, velocity, acceleration powers.
Input order has no mathematical role, but every surviving exponent tuple must retain its coefficient. Empty terms means the zero polynomial, whose degree remains undefined.
poly_add: Add two finite formal polynomials over rational coefficients.
Cancellation must remove a term exactly. A missing empirical measurement is never encoded as a zero polynomial by this operation.
poly_multiply: Distribute every pair of terms and combine equal exponent triples.
The cross term is essential for binomial products. Enforce input and expansion budgets before allowing an unbounded product.
d_phi: Differentiate formally with respect to the field coordinate q.
Velocity and acceleration are independent jet coordinates during this partial derivative. A zero result is a formal statement about the declared expression.
d_velocity: Differentiate formally with respect to the velocity coordinate v.
A velocity-linear term has a nonzero first derivative and zero Hessian; these observations serve different purposes.
jet_degree: Report total degree and each coordinate degree after exact cancellation.
Component maxima may arise in different monomials and must not be summed to obtain total degree. Zero has null degrees.
field_parity: Classify simultaneous sign reversal of q, v and a by total exponent parity.
This is a declared algebraic symmetry check. It does not establish a symmetry of an unspecified physical action or its boundary conditions.
coordinate_scale: Substitute independent rational coordinate scales without changing exponent labels.
Zero scales are permitted as substitutions here; unlike affine pullback they are not claimed to be invertible coordinate transformations.
jet_value: Evaluate a finite polynomial at a complete rational triple q, v, a.
Values are exact evaluations at declared synthetic points. They carry no sensor, calibration, data collection or trajectory provenance.
coefficient_at: Read the coefficient at a specific nonnegative exponent triple after normalization.
An absent formal monomial has coefficient zero under this closed polynomial contract. This does not make an absent scientific dataset a measured zero.
time_derivative: Apply D_t P = v P_q + a P_v to an autonomous first-jet polynomial.
Acceleration-dependent input would require a jerk coordinate and is refused. Explicit time dependence is outside this declared operator.
euler_lagrange: Form E(L) = D_t(L_v) - L_q with a fixed sign convention.
The input is an explicitly declared first-order autonomous toy Lagrangian. The result is a conditional residual, not a derivation of the historical GMUT tensor placeholders.
energy_polynomial: Form H(q,v) = v L_v - L in jet coordinates.
This expression is not automatically a Hamiltonian written in canonical momentum. No globally invertible Legendre map or physical energy interpretation is asserted.
kinetic_point: Evaluate the velocity Hessian L_vv at a declared rational point.
A nonzero Hessian marks a regular Legendre point in this finite model. A zero Hessian is not proof that every possible inverse fails; neither sign certifies global stability.
energy_identity: Check the off-shell identity D_t H - v E(L) = 0 for autonomous first-order polynomials.
The identity is conditional algebra. Conservation along an actual solution also requires the equations, a valid solution and the intended physical interpretation.
potential_point: Evaluate the field derivative and curvature of a field-only potential.
A stationary point with zero curvature is unresolved at quadratic order. No physical vacuum, stable state or measured parameter is established.
boundary_equivalence: Compare a stated boundary addition D_t F(q) with the actual difference of two actions.
The declared generator and residual comparison are separate outputs. Equal equations alone cannot establish every global boundary, topology or quantum equivalence claim.
affine_pullback: Expand q = s Q + b and v = s V for a nonzero rational slope.
The pullback is an invertible coordinate representation in the finite model. It is not a field-theory equivalence proof or a change in source evidence status.
model_obligations: Project explicit missing evidence roles for five out-of-model claim classes.
Providing all role labels only empties a bookkeeping list. It never verifies evidence contents, closes the source placeholders or grants scientific and production authority.
release_gate: Retain five protected requests as exact gates under synthetic evidence.
An authority string cannot grant authority. Real review, affected governance and Māori authority cannot be synthesized by a successful software check.

first_jet: no acceleration in L or P for time/variational operators
